accepted_basis: actual exam source authority uses external-primary prompt and correction evidence
textbook source remains owned-source only and not official exam authority
split source/question layout is directionally useful

blocking_findings.summary: Check buttons mark completion without evaluating answers.
Rendered controls do not preserve real task-family affordances.
Prompts do not consistently state exact action, allowed input source, answer form, and expected count.
Correction-model and procedure support is visible as default source context.
Current checker validates layout/counts more than task clarity and affordance.

prompt_comments.SHAREDINGEST-Q1: Actual-exam source authority is much improved, but correction-model formula support must move out of default source context.
prompt_comments.SHAREDINGEST-Q2: Layout repair is useful; blocker is unclear controls and missing task-family affordances.
prompt_comments.SHAREDINGEST-Q3: Actual-exam task cards are not playable enough; generic inputs and blank textareas are insufficient.
prompt_comments.SHAREDINGEST-Q4: Underlying traces avoid final-answer-only reduction, but rendered lab still collapses too much into open textareas.
prompt_comments.SHAREDINGEST-Q5: Textbook source authority is correctly bounded as owned-source only.
prompt_comments.SHAREDINGEST-Q6: Textbook layout is readable as prototype, but questions are too open and support is too visible.
prompt_comments.SHAREDINGEST-Q7: Ambiguity is recorded, but the prompt must say whether one interval, all intervals, or ambiguity explanation is expected.
prompt_comments.SHAREDINGEST-Q8: Maps and traces are promising, but rendered controls must preserve task-family interactions.
prompt_comments.SHAREDINGEST-Q9: Screenshots/proof judge layout only, not clarity, answer affordance, or correctness handling.
prompt_comments.SHAREDINGEST-Q10: No product-authority overclaim; issue is insufficient playable quality.
prompt_comments.SHAREDINGEST-Q11: Run a playable repair sprint with real controls, hidden support, concrete prompts, semantic checking, retry evidence, and updated checker.
